description_en: Lists the associations between resource discoveries and IP Address Managers (IPAMs)
description_zh: 查询资源发现和IPAM的关联关系
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam list-ipam-resource-discovery-associations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-id ipam-ccxbnsbhew0d6t0000 --ipam-resource-discovery-id ipam-res-disco-jt5f2af2u6nk2z3210000 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpamResourceDiscoveryAssociations

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPAM instance
parameters.name: ipam_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource discovery instance
parameters.name: ipam_resource_discovery_id

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

For the first query, leave this parameter empty.

For a subsequent query, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from the previous response
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的具体条目数

IpamId.description_en: The ID of the IPAM instance

IpamResourceDiscoveryId.description_en: The ID of the resource discovery instance

IpamResourceDiscoveryOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the resource discovery instance
IpamResourceDiscoveryOwnerId.description_zh: 资源发现实例归属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

IpamResourceDiscoveryStatus.description_en:
The status of the resource discovery instance. Valid values:

Creating

Created

Modifying

Deleting

Deleted
IpamResourceDiscoveryStatus.description_zh:
资源发现实例的状态。取值：
Creating：表示创建中。
Created：表示创建完成。
Modifying：表示修改中。
Deleting：表示删除中。
Deleted：表示已删除

IpamResourceDiscoveryType.description_en:
The type of the resource discovery. Valid values:

system: a default resource discovery that is automatically created by the system.

custom: a custom resource discovery that is created by a user
IpamResourceDiscoveryType.description_zh:
资源发现的类型。取值：
system：表示系统创建的默认资源发现。
custom：表示用户创建的自定义类型的资源发现

Status.description_en:
The association status. Valid values:

Created

Deleted
Status.description_zh:
关联关系状态。取值：

Created：表示已创建。
Deleted：表示已删除

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10

NextToken.description_en:
The token to use to retrieve the next page of results. This value is empty when there are no more results to return.

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query is needed.

If NextToken is not empty, its value is the token to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that match the query criteria
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总量
